scripts:
create service user studio-dam-processor
set ACL for studio-dam-processor
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /content/dam
end

create path /conf(sling:Folder)/global(sling:Folder)/settings(sling:Folder)/dam(sling:Folder)/processing(sling:Folder)
set ACL for studio-dam-processor
    allow jcr:read on /conf/global/settings/dam
end

create path /var(sling:Folder)/studio(sling:Folder)/dam(sling:Folder)/linkshare(sling:Folder)
create service user studio-dam-linkshare
set ACL for studio-dam-linkshare
    allow jcr:read on /content/dam
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/dam/linkshare
end

create path /var(sling:Folder)/studio(sling:Folder)/dam(sling:Folder)/index(nt:unstructured)
create service user studio-dam-indexer
set ACL for studio-dam-indexer
    allow jcr:read,rep:write,rep:indexDefinitionManagement on /oak:index
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/dam/index
end
set ACL for everyone
    allow jcr:read on /var/studio/dam/index
end
set ACL for studio-dam-processor
    allow jcr:read on /var/studio/dam/index
end

create path /var(sling:Folder)/studio(sling:Folder)/dam(sling:Folder)/reports(sling:Folder)
create service user studio-dam-reports
set ACL for studio-dam-reports
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/dam/reports
    allow jcr:read on /var/studio/dam/linkshare
end
set ACL for everyone
    deny jcr:read on /var/studio/dam/reports
end

create path /content/cq:tags
set ACL for studio-dam-processor
    allow jcr:read on /content/cq:tags
end

create path /var(sling:Folder)/studio(sling:Folder)/dam(sling:Folder)/downloads(sling:Folder)
create service user studio-dam-downloads
set ACL for studio-dam-downloads
    allow jcr:read on /content/dam
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/dam/downloads
end
set ACL for everyone
    deny jcr:read on /var/studio/dam/downloads
end

create service user studio-dam-livecopy
set ACL for studio-dam-livecopy
    allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:readAccessControl on /content/dam
    allow jcr:read on /home
end

create path /conf(sling:Folder)/global(sling:Folder)/settings(sling:Folder)/dam(sling:Folder)/gallerypresets(sling:Folder)
set ACL for everyone
    allow jcr:read on /conf/global/settings/dam/gallerypresets
end

create path /var(sling:Folder)/studio(sling:Folder)/dam(sling:Folder)/notifications(sling:Folder)
create service user studio-dam-notifications
set ACL for studio-dam-notifications
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/dam/notifications
    allow jcr:read on /home
end
set ACL for everyone
    deny jcr:read on /var/studio/dam/notifications
end
